tasks.short: Research applicable law and assess its implications for an active matter.

steps.what: Define legal questions, relevant facts, jurisdictions and research dates.
Search a legal research database in {OTHER} and retrieve potentially relevant authorities.
Read authorities, trace citations and record relevant passages and conflicting interpretations.

loop.input: Research scope and retrieved, licensed source texts with version dates.
loop.output: Authority notes with quotations, pinpoint references, conflicts and coverage gaps.
loop.check: Resolve every citation against retrieved text; lawyer checks material quotations, status and omitted adverse authorities.
loop.stop: One pass and at most two repair attempts within the retrieved bundle; unresolved gaps return to lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Search retrieves texts, but relevance and competing interpretations depend on free-text legal reasoning.

steps.what: Apply authorities to facts and decide implications, uncertainty and further research needs.
Write and send a cited advice note to the matter owner.

loop.input: Lawyer's legal assessment and checked authority notes.
loop.output: Advice note separating conclusions, uncertainty and recommended actions.
loop.check: Trace legal assertions to checked notes; lawyer approves meaning, recipients and attachments before sending.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported assertions or new legal questions return to lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates provide structure, but the explanation must reflect matter-specific reasoning.

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in the legal research database in {OTHER}, and retain dated sources in {DOCS}. A bounded answer desk on {DATA_PLATFORM} produces cited reading notes and drafts advice from the lawyer's assessment; the lawyer checks authorities and approves delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source licensing, changing law and unreliable citation handling made unattended research costly. Applying law to disputed facts still required a lawyer.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing search features and faster integration development reduce retrieval work. Bounded text extraction can prepare notes with verifiable source references.
tasks.still_hard: Checking completeness, adverse authorities, territorial scope and historical versions remains expensive. A valid citation does not establish a sound interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The lawyer identifies legally decisive facts, weighs competing authorities and accepts responsibility for the advice.

ambition.what: Weekly legal-change impact triage for active disputes.

tasks.altitude: The lawyer spends less time assembling authorities and more time testing interpretations with matter owners. Formal advice and litigation decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Maintain dated authority bundles and flag superseded sources.
reach.learn: Source hierarchy, version checking, pinpoint citations and the limits of citation validation.

evidence.claim: Libra supports legal research, drafting and review over legislation, case law and commentary.
A documented legal-research benchmark found material error rates, supporting manual checks of relied-on authorities.
Dutch professional guidance keeps the lawyer responsible and requires checking citations and case law.
The proposed workflow, remaining-time estimates and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured customer results.

assumptions: Baseline is an in-house lawyer in a European company with 200 to 2,000 staff.
Document reading dominates today; mailbox coordination is a small share.
The research database supports saved searches or an approved export path.
Build ranges cover a pilot for one jurisdiction and source collection, not a new legal database.
GDPR applies to personal data; confidentiality and national professional rules constrain source processing.
unknowns: Jurisdictions, practice areas and source subscriptions.
Rights to retrieve, retain and process licensed texts.
Available interfaces, matter access controls and retention requirements.
Whether national employee consultation requirements apply to the proposed logging.
research_questions: Can the source interface reliably expose historical versions, subsequent treatment and pinpoint references?
How well do citation checks and lawyer review detect errors on a representative, independently assessed matter sample?
new_work: Check material quotations, adverse authorities and unresolved coverage gaps.
Maintain source connectors, permissions and version rules.
Review failed citation checks and record why generated notes were rejected.
Complete processor-contract, access and applicable employee-consultation work before rollout.

tasks.short: Prepare, negotiate and document settlements of civil disputes.

steps.what: Assemble claims, correspondence, evidence and the current dispute chronology.

loop.input: Selected case documents and dispute correspondence.
loop.output: Dispute brief with sourced chronology, claimed amounts and disputed facts.
loop.check: Link each event to its source; reconcile amounts deterministically; lawyer checks material omissions and contradictions.
loop.stop: One pass and at most two repairs on the selected bundle; missing evidence becomes an explicit question.
loop.why_not_simpler: Evidence and disputed assertions arrive in varied narrative documents.

steps.what: Assess exposure, settlement options, nonfinancial interests and negotiating limits.
Agree settlement authority, escalation triggers and acceptable trade-offs.
Negotiate offers and concessions with the other party within the agreed mandate.
Draft settlement wording and resolve differences between provisional terms and the written agreement.

loop.input: Provisional terms, settlement mandate and approved settlement clauses.
loop.output: Settlement draft and a list of missing or inconsistent terms.
loop.check: Check amounts, parties, dates and mandate limits by rules; lawyer checks releases, enforceability and negotiated meaning.
loop.stop: One draft and two revisions; unresolved terms or mandate departures return to the lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle standard clauses, but negotiated releases and obligations need matter-specific wording.

steps.what: Approve final economics and any departures from the settlement mandate.
Sign the approved settlement and obtain the other party's executed counterpart.

tasks.design: A bounded generator builds a sourced dispute brief from {DOCS} and selected {EMAIL} records, then assembles settlement drafts from approved clauses. Configure {WORKFLOW} to record mandates and approvals, route approved agreements through {ESIGN}, and hand payment obligations to the finance team in {ERP}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dispute evidence and negotiated terms vary widely. Preparation, drafting and approval tracking were intertwined with conversations that depend on trust and authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked extraction, reusable clause generators and existing approval features make preparation and paperwork easier to change independently.
tasks.still_hard: Credibility, hidden interests, enforceability and the timing of concessions remain human work. An agreement can conceal unresolved disagreement about its meaning.
tasks.human_edge: The lawyer reads the relationship, tests commitments and negotiates concessions without losing the client's essential interests.

ambition.what: Early settlement assessment clinic for low-value supplier disputes.

tasks.altitude: The lawyer has more preparation time for difficult conversations and can offer earlier settlement assessments. Settlement authority remains with the existing business sponsor and signatories.

reach.task: Prepare settlement execution packs and track agreed obligations.
reach.learn: Release scope, conditional obligations, signature authority and escalation triggers.

evidence.claim: Legora offers document-set review and drafting capabilities relevant to dispute preparation.
Ashurst reported first-draft legal briefing time savings in its trial; this does not establish settlement negotiation savings.
GDPR Article 28 provides requirements for processor arrangements when processing personal data.
Human negotiation supported by template drafting and configured approval routing is a proposed design.

assumptions: The lawyer acts for the company in civil disputes, rather than serving as a neutral mediator.
Preparation and paperwork are separable from negotiation, consistent with the task's human-work prior.
Shares describe a representative negotiation cycle; failed negotiations can repeat several steps.
Build ranges cover one dispute category with approved clauses and an existing signature route.
GDPR and national rules apply; use by an ADR body would require a separate EU AI Act scope assessment.
unknowns: Settlement limits, approval thresholds and authority to bind the company.
Dispute types, sensitive evidence categories and applicable confidentiality duties.
Signature methods and counterpart acceptance requirements.
Applicable national employee consultation requirements and permitted activity logging.
research_questions: Which settlement terms recur enough for approved templates without narrowing legitimate negotiation options?
Can source-linked briefs distinguish allegations, admissions and established facts reliably?
new_work: Review extracted chronology, disputed facts and draft releases.
Maintain approved clauses and settlement authority thresholds.
Handle missing approvals, counterpart changes and failed signature requests.
Check processor terms, access controls and applicable consultation requirements.

tasks.short: Allocate legal assistants' work, review quality and coach their development.

steps.what: Collect progress replies, deadlines and outstanding questions from legal assistants.
Assign priorities and work according to deadlines, competence, capacity and conflicts.
Explain instructions, expected outputs, legal context and escalation points.
Review submitted work, resolve substantive issues and authorise its release.

loop.input: Submitted work, task briefing and approved review checklist.
loop.output: Preflight findings with document locations and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Rules check required fields and dates; lawyer validates findings, substantive reasoning and release readiness.
loop.stop: One preflight pass and one repair; substantive uncertainty stays with the lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Completeness rules are deterministic, but contradictions and instruction mismatches can be expressed in free text.

steps.what: Discuss feedback, wellbeing, recurring mistakes and development goals with the assistant.
Re-enter assignment status and deadlines in a separate weekly supervision summary.

tasks.design: Configure a shared queue in {PROJECT} with owners, deadlines, briefing templates and reminders through {CHAT}. A bounded preflight checks work in {DOCS} before lawyer review, while a live queue view replaces the duplicate supervision summary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status updates sat in conversations while review evidence sat in documents. Useful automation was often confused with automating supervision or scoring staff.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing task-management features can centralise status. Small integrations and bounded document checks can reduce coordination without replacing allocation judgement or coaching.
tasks.still_hard: Competence, workload, confidence and the seriousness of an error require context. Automated findings can create extra review work and must not become unvalidated performance scores.
tasks.human_edge: The lawyer recognises when someone needs support, judges safe delegation and gives feedback that builds professional judgement.

ambition.what: Weekly coached drafting clinic for legal assistants.

tasks.altitude: The lawyer spends less time chasing status and more time reviewing difficult work and coaching. Delegation authority remains unchanged; any broader assistant responsibilities need explicit approval.

reach.task: Triage incomplete matter requests and prepare review-ready work packs.
reach.learn: Risk-based escalation, evidence organisation and clear statements of unresolved legal questions.

evidence.claim: Configured task records, deadline rules and notifications can support legal administration without a model.
Legora supports document review; the digest does not establish automated supervision or employee assessment.
In the Netherlands, employee-output logging can engage works-council consent requirements under article 27.
The proposed time shares and remaining-time estimates preserve substantial human review and coaching.

assumptions: A small legal team already uses {PROJECT}, with progress details also exchanged through {EMAIL} and {CHAT}.
The separate supervision summary repeats operational status; any required substantive supervision record is retained.
Model findings concern work completeness and document inconsistencies, not staff ranking.
Human coordination and review dominate, consistent with the priors.
GDPR applies; national consultation rules vary. Employee evaluation or allocation based on personal characteristics would require a separate EU AI Act assessment.
unknowns: Current assignment tools and required supervision records.
Team size, assistant competence levels and approved delegation limits.
Whether existing policies permit document preflight processing.
Applicable national consultation duties, employee representatives and existing logging agreements.
research_questions: Which review defects can preflight detect without generating excessive false alarms?
Which operational data are necessary for coordination, and which can be omitted from logging?
new_work: Maintain briefing templates, delegation limits and review checklists.
Resolve stale queue entries and incorrect reminders.
Review preflight false alarms and missed defects.
Consult employees or representatives where national rules require it and review access to supervision records.

tasks.short: Prepare negotiating positions, negotiate contract terms and secure an approved signed agreement.

steps.what: Provide the proposed agreement, commercial objectives and required completion date.
Compare proposed clauses with approved positions and identify omissions and departures.

loop.input: Proposed agreement, commercial requirements and versioned contract playbook.
loop.output: Clause-linked issues list with omissions, departures and suggested approved fallbacks.
loop.check: Validate clause references and playbook versions; lawyer checks material classifications and missing issues.
loop.stop: One pass and at most two repairs; novel clauses and conflicting requirements return to lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact comparison handles known text, but counterpart clauses express similar risks in varied language.

steps.what: Choose negotiation priorities, acceptable fallbacks and matters requiring business approval.
Negotiate disputed terms and trade-offs with the counterparty.
Revise clauses, reconcile versions and circulate the agreed contract wording.

loop.input: Latest agreement, recorded negotiated terms and approved clauses.
loop.output: Revised agreement, change comparison and deviation record.
loop.check: Rules check defined terms, amounts, dates and cross-references; lawyer verifies meaning and approves circulation.
loop.stop: One revision and two repair attempts per agreed term set; conflicting versions return to lawyer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Clause insertion and comparison are deterministic, but bespoke negotiated wording needs bounded drafting.

steps.what: Approve commercial commitments and escalated deviations from agreed contract positions.
Sign the approved agreement and obtain the counterparty's executed counterpart.

tasks.design: Configure structured intake, playbooks and approval routing in {CLM}, using {WORKFLOW} only where native features are missing. A deterministic comparison and clause generator uses bounded loops for semantic deviations and bespoke wording in {DOCS}; people negotiate, approve circulation and sign through {ESIGN}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Version handling and approvals crossed documents and mailboxes. Clause wording varied too much for exact matching, while acceptable trade-offs depended on commercial context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing contract-management configuration handles intake and routing. Faster integration development and bounded clause classification make a narrow playbook-based pilot practical.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual liability structures, interacting clauses and unrecorded concessions need experienced review. A clause can match the playbook while remaining unsuitable for the transaction.
tasks.human_edge: The lawyer converts business priorities into defensible trade-offs and recognises when a technically acceptable term damages the commercial relationship.

ambition.what: Weekly review of unresolved liability and data-use deviations across open negotiations.

tasks.altitude: The lawyer spends less time comparing text and reconciling versions, and more time resolving consequential deviations. Existing commercial approval and signature rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Maintain contract version histories and assemble deviation approval packs.
reach.learn: Clause dependencies, approval thresholds and how to distinguish textual changes from changed obligations.

evidence.claim: Legora supports legal document review and drafting, including work within document editing.
Ashurst's documented trial found drafting gains; it does not establish equivalent gains in contract negotiation.
Dutch professional guidance requires responsible lawyer checking and protects confidential information.
Configured intake, version comparison, clause assembly and approval routing are the proposed deterministic foundation.

assumptions: The company has a basic {CLM}, approved clauses and a delegated authority framework.
The intake step automates collection and routing; the business owner still supplies commercial requirements.
Meetings and documents dominate the baseline; substantive negotiation also repeats through correspondence.
Build ranges cover one contract family and one approval route.
GDPR, confidentiality obligations and national rules apply. This commercial legal support does not by itself constitute judicial or ADR decision-making under the EU AI Act.
unknowns: Contract families, languages, volumes and recurring deviation types.
Playbook quality and the availability of approved fallback clauses.
Native {CLM} capabilities, interfaces and version identifiers.
Authority thresholds, required specialist approvals and applicable national consultation duties.
research_questions: Can clause classification detect interacting obligations and omissions across the whole agreement?
Which existing {CLM} features cover intake, comparisons and approvals before custom code is justified?
new_work: Review suggested deviations, bespoke wording and unresolved version conflicts.
Maintain clause libraries, playbooks and authority thresholds.
Monitor connector failures and signature routing exceptions.
Review processor terms, access rights and applicable employee consultation before rollout.

role.altitude: The lawyer's week shifts from collecting sources, comparing documents and chasing status toward legal interpretation, negotiation and coaching. Legal accountability and formal approval rights remain with the existing authorised roles.
reach: Help paralegals prepare sourced research bundles and deviation packs.
Help legal assistants triage incomplete requests and identify escalation points.
skills_to_grow: Design source checks that test completeness as well as citation validity.
Translate recurring legal requirements into templates, playbooks and explicit escalation rules.
Evaluate bounded model outputs against representative legal work.
Coach assistants in evidence quality, uncertainty and safe delegation.
Assess data access, confidentiality and applicable national consultation requirements.
role.ambitious_version: Provide a regular early-risk service: weekly legal-change triage, contract-deviation review and an early settlement clinic, supported by reusable preparation tools and human legal judgement.
